title: Shift maps and statistical invariants for some dynamical systems
summary: Given a dynamical system, we study the so-called space of shift functions thus introducing another vision on bifurcations and chaos. As an application of the obtained results, we give a partial solution to an open problem formulated in \cite{Misiurewicz1}: to describe all the one-dimensional maps with all the periodic orbits having the same mean value. Moreover, we show that there are continuous families of such mappings having infinitely many periodic points.
